doc.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995

title: Vaudeville acts Gallodoro backed
summary: Gallodoro says his musical parents loved his career and lists acts he played with, including Bob Hope, Milton Berle, Edgar Bergen and the Three Stooges.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: How did your parents feel about this career?

Oh, they loved it. Yeah. Because they were all musical. They were all musical. I played with Bob Hope back in 1930, ‘31, ‘32, before he was even known, Milton Berle, the ventriloquist, Edgar Bergen, the original Three Stooges.
Yeah, the original Three Stooges. Oh, God, so many acts that you can’t remember, you know?
